title: Seed acceptance formula size bound
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean PCPP system with $r$ verifier queries, and let $s$ be any seed of its verifier. The size of the CNF formula encoding acceptance for seed $s$ is at most $2^r$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean PCPP system with $r$ verifier queries
